selected: Four M569A forks for two SH946E short low-speed brake connections; one common M568A 12.7mm pin and one 1/8 x 1 inch split pin per fork, and two 3/4 inch plain U.S. Std. nuts per rod.
source_supported: SNL87:002 applies four M569A forks, length 1″, to SH946E (2 per rod).
SNL136:007 explicitly applies M568A 1-5/8 inch pins and 1/8x1 inch cotters to M569A and M569B. 41.275mm pin length datum is modeled under head.
SNL195:019 confirms two 3/4 inch plain nuts per SH946E connecting rod assembly.
Common 12.7mm pin shank and 13.0mm receiving bores reconciled in pin_family_integrated01.

fork_datum_resolution.datum_conflict: SNL87:002 prints length 1″ without a datum. Both front (Def_BrakeFront_lever) and rear (Def_RearControlFulcrum_lever_low_left/right) receivers have rounded tips of 18.0-19.05mm radius around the 13.0mm bore.
fork_datum_resolution.rejected_diagnostic: A pin-centre-to-rod-seat interpretation with 22.225mm receiver-clearing throat leaves only 3.175mm of threaded socket, failing the 19.05mm (1 diameter) thread engagement criterion. That combination is rejected and preserved in LowForkDatumDiagnostic.
fork_datum_resolution.selected_hypothesis: The 1 inch dimension describes the threaded shank / socket length (throat_to_rod_seat). Estimated throat depth of 23.8125mm (15/16″) clears the starboard fulcrum arm entering at -56.89° (extending to 22.6738mm) with 1.14mm margin. This provides 25.4mm of available thread envelope (satisfying >= 19.05mm engagement) and a pin-center to rod-seat distance of 49.2125mm (1-15/16″).
retained_alternatives: Catalogue clerical abbreviation or error for 1-1/2″ or 1-3/4″ standard clevis.
Compact receiver eye profile allowing shorter throat.
Pin-centre-to-face with non-standard reduced thread engagement.

approximations: D-profile fork ears, 11.1125mm ear stock, 23.8125mm throat, 28.575mm shoulder and 12.7mm socket radius are estimates.
Common M568A 12.7mm shank and 13.0mm fork bore match the reconciled pin family.
Nominal threaded envelopes, 0.25mm side clearance, 0.15mm pin radial clearance and 0.1mm rod radial clearance are modeling choices.

Joint poses place front forks with transverse horizontal pins (pointing in +X) and rear forks with vertical pins clocked along the horizontal rod vector toward the front brake eye to clear the lever arm without interference.
limits: No rods, M567 washers or physical springs are added in this joint increment; rod closure follows in low_rods01.
Full motion, adjustment and service paths remain unqualified.
